title: Cloud City: Migration & Modernization: The 6 Rs & Wave Planning

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: The old industrial waterfront was sinking. Factories had rusty boilers, proprietary plumbing, and no electrical schematics.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Urban Planners categorized every factory: some to move brick-by-brick (Rehost), some to upgrade with modern boilers (Replatform), and some to demolish completely (Retain/Retire).

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: During the hospital relocation, power was kept active in both the old clinic and new hospital simultaneously until the final patient was moved.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Moving brick factories takes years; cloud migrations can replicate petabytes of data over high-speed Interconnect in days.
